001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import android.net.Uri;
004import androidx.room.Database;
005import androidx.room.RoomDatabase;
006import androidx.room.TypeConverter;
007import androidx.room.TypeConverters;
008import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.PinDao;
009import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.TrackDao;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.UserDao;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
012import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Track;
013import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
014import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.PinDatabase.Converters;
015import java.time.Instant;
016
017/**
018 * PinDatabase is an abstract representation of the Room database implementation for the application's
019 * underlying storage. It provides access to Data Access Objects (DAOs) for database operations on
020 * entities such as {@link Pin}, {@link Track}, and {@link User}.
021 *
022 * Features:
023 * - Manages database creation and version management using Room.
024 * - Uses entity classes to structure and map the database schema.
025 * - Incorporates type converters for type transformations between database values and application values.
026 *
027 * The database is configured with the following properties:
028 * - The database schema includes {@link Pin}, {@link Track}, and {@link User} entities.
029 * - The version is managed by the {@code VERSION} constant.
030 * - Type converters are provided via the {@link Converters} class to handle custom data types such as
031 *   {@link Instant} and {@link Uri}.
032 */
033@Database(entities = {Pin.class, Track.class, User.class}, version = PinDatabase.VERSION)
034@TypeConverters(Converters.class)
035public abstract class PinDatabase extends RoomDatabase {
036
037  static final int VERSION = 1;
038  private static final String DATABASE_NAME = "pins";
039
040  public static String getDatabaseName() {
041    return DATABASE_NAME;
042  }
043
044  public abstract PinDao getPinDao();
045
046  public abstract UserDao getUserDao();
047
048  public abstract TrackDao getTrackDao();
049
050  /**
051   * Provides type conversion methods for Room database to handle custom data types.
052   *
053   * This utility class is referenced via the {@code @TypeConverters(Converters.class)} annotation in
054   * classes such as {@code PinDatabase}. It is responsible for converting between custom types and
055   * primitive types that the database can store, ensuring seamless integration between the database
056   * schema and the application's object model.
057   *
058   * Methods in this class include:
059   * - Conversion of {@link Instant} objects to {@link Long} values, representing milliseconds
060   *   since the Unix epoch, and vice versa.
061   * - Conversion of {@link Uri} objects to their {@link String} representations usable by the database,
062   *   and vice versa.
063   */
064  public static class Converters {
065
066    @TypeConverter
067    public static Long fromInstant(Instant value) {
068      return (value != null) ? value.toEpochMilli() : null;
069    }
070
071    @TypeConverter
072    public static Instant fromLong(Long value) {
073      return (value != null) ? Instant.ofEpochMilli(value) : null;
074    }
075
076    @TypeConverter
077    public static String fromUri(Uri value) {
078      return (value != null) ? value.toString() : null;
079    }
080
081    @TypeConverter
082    public static Uri fromString(String value) {
083      return (value != null) ? Uri.parse(value) : null;
084    }
085  }
086}
